intervention: Only the frozen historical experiment-method JSON book differs. Both targets receive an empty lesson and the same current paid calibration, candidates, tools and limits. No historical concepts or fitted instruments transfer.
preparation: Two 24-row meter trajectories fit the instrument; an independent 24-row trajectory assesses it. The original benchmark supplies gains 1 and 2 plus the null law; event cases also include the window alternative. Preparation is charged in every episode. No response experiment or final model is selected by the runner.
transfer: Extract the two full method books from the existing measured v0.76 run. Retain its counterexamples and conditions. Target feedback never reaches another target.
terminal: All source and target agents stop before the original fixture generates four terminal random/activation/exit trajectories. Report random fresh confirmation separately from unique candidate identification and terminal prediction.
limitations: Two matched development cases, supplied response candidates and paid initial calibration. This tests LLM consumption of the v0.76 method book, not autonomous candidate invention, stable average advantage, or the v0.92 instrument-extension capability.
